challenge.statement: Show that shared norms, practices or artefacts predict coordination or interpretation after incentives, information, repeated interaction and network position are represented.
challenge.failureAction: Narrow the cultural-scaffold claim to whichever measured mechanisms retain incremental value.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: Distributed reduction of cognitive and coordination work.
thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Aesthetic, sacred, affective and embodied cultural functions.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: Researchers choose which cultural functions count as measurable work.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Remove culture as an independent explanatory variable where decomposed mechanisms fully absorb it.

challenge.statement: Demonstrate discriminant validity among empirical expectation, normative expectation, sanction expectation, endorsement and observed conformity.
challenge.failureAction: Collapse empirically inseparable components and stop interpreting self-report as causal.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: Different reasons people may follow the same apparent rule.
thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Habitual, identity-based or sacred adherence not represented as expectation.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: The measurement model can define genuine normativity too narrowly.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Expectation reports are post hoc rationalization or demand response.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Retire any component lacking reliable independent manipulation or measurement.

challenge.statement: Separate rule effects, member sorting, migration, administrator turnover and reverse cultural influence using temporal or quasi-experimental evidence.
challenge.failureAction: Report association only and prohibit causal direction language.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: Reciprocal development of rules and member culture.
thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: External shocks, platform infrastructure and resource inequality.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: Administratively visible rule changes may be over-weighted relative to informal resistance.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Selection and composition account for the association.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Withdraw bidirectional causation where temporal designs cannot reject sorting.

challenge.statement: Replicate category convergence while varying network structure and holding stimulus, task demand and incentive constant; distinguish convergence from accuracy.
challenge.failureAction: Restrict the claim to the exact experimental task and population.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: How communication networks compress classificatory diversity.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: Converged classifications may be treated as natural or legitimate.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Shared stimulus salience or task demand produces convergence.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Remove general network claims when randomized topology or scale has no effect.

challenge.statement: Identify an independently corroborated class of error whose discovery or correction changes when reporting, category, standing or aggregation rules change.
challenge.failureAction: Do not equate increased reporting or appeal volume with improved institutional knowledge.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: Translation of experience into official records and decisions.
thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Privacy, confidentiality, tacit expertise and legitimate non-recording.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: The audit defines both error and authoritative corroboration.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Apparent invisibility reflects signal quality, privacy or decision cost.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Narrow to documented pipelines where rule changes alter corroborated error detection.

challenge.statement: Specify proportionate standing while representing expertise, privacy, anti-harassment protections, decision latency and correction cost.
challenge.failureAction: Downgrade from a general defect criterion to a domain-specific governance proposal.

thirdOrderAudit.makesLegible: Who can contest consequential classifications and at what cost.
thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Legitimate role differentiation and bounded expert authority.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: The programme can appoint itself representative of affected parties.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Expanded standing may impair accuracy, privacy or timely action.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Reject equal-standing formulations where they predictably externalize greater harm.

challenge.statement: Freeze the transformation codebook before confirmatory coding and demonstrate held-out enrichment beyond base-rate, shuffled-sequence, genre-matched, transmission and coder-template nulls.
challenge.failureAction: Retire the strong cross-cultural invariant claim if generic story grammar and transmission match its held-out performance.

thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Performance, ritual context, polysemy, sacred restriction and local interpretation.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: Programme-selected categories may manufacture the universal they seek.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Generic narrative structure plus transmission and archive bias.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Remove every family failing reliability or held-out discrimination; retain no complete cycle by default.

challenge.statement: Demonstrate that the available provenance and corpus structure can identify descent, borrowing, convergence, selection and coder effects rather than merely naming them.
challenge.failureAction: Report explanatory underdetermination and prohibit allocation among unidentifiable mechanisms.

thirdOrderAudit.maySuppress: Unknown contact histories and losses from oral transmission.
thirdOrderAudit.authorityEffect: Quantified model weights may appear more historically certain than the corpus warrants.
thirdOrderAudit.rivalPreserved: Mechanisms are not separately identifiable from surviving records.
thirdOrderAudit.subtractionCondition: Replace causal allocation with bounded compatibility claims when models are observationally equivalent.

codingReliability.exploratoryBand: 0.67 <= alpha < 0.80, reported but excluded from primary invariant claims
codingReliability.removalThreshold: alpha < 0.67 after one pre-confirmatory manual revision

heldOutEvaluation.multiplicity: false-discovery-rate q <= 0.05 across prespecified transformation families
heldOutEvaluation.modelComparison: orientation codebook must improve held-out predictive score over every prespecified generic baseline with uncertainty interval excluding zero
heldOutEvaluation.robustness: direction must survive archive-source, translation and major-region leave-one-group-out sensitivity analyses

institutionalStudies.claimRule: no causal language without randomized, interrupted-time-series, regression-discontinuity or defensible difference-in-differences identification
institutionalStudies.affectedPartyGate: normative evaluation requires measured distribution of reporting, appeal and correction cost
institutionalStudies.convergenceGuard: category convergence and category accuracy must always be reported separately

proposedNumericalGates.qualification: These are preregistration proposals, not retrospectively optimized thresholds. Corpus inventory and design simulation may justify revision before registration, with every change versioned.
